theorems.name: Submission.mcm_exp_neg_integral_ftc
theorems.statement: ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ) (R : ℝ), IntegrableOn g (Ioc 0 R) → IntegrableOn (fun τ ↦ -(g τ * Real.exp (-∫ s in Ioc 0 τ, g s))) (Ioc 0 R) ∧ ∀ σ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ σ → σ ≤ t → t ≤ R → Real.exp (-∫ s in Ioc 0 t, g s) = Real.exp (-∫ s in Ioc 0 σ, g s) + ∫ τ in Ioc σ t, -(g τ * Real.exp (-∫ s in Ioc 0 τ, g s))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
